title: Moscow Parking Occupancy: 4.6M half-hourly snapshots
subtitle: 210 municipal parking lots, 30-minute granularity, continuous since March 2025

resources.description: Static metadata for 210 municipal parking lots: name, address, nearest metro, WGS-84 coordinates, total/common/accessible capacity.
Occupancy snapshots every 30 minutes: time (UTC), parking_id, free_spaces, free_handicapped_spaces, occupancy_rate (0-100, computed over common spaces only).
